$comment: Single source of truth for every visual asset. status: placeholder = generated stand-in, must be replaced; wip = real art, still being iterated; final = approved. `file` is relative to src/assets. Entries with kind 'pixels' are tiny sprites authored inline as palette-indexed rows (palette names refer to PALETTE in src/game/GameConfig.ts).

assets.usage: The player's soul in battle: a lost-and-found claim tag. Also the title-screen ornament.
assets.brief: Pointed claim tag with a punched hole. Needs a hit flash frame and a 'torn' variant for the defeat sequence.

assets.usage: Title screen wordmark.
assets.brief: Stamped 'UNCLAIMED' wordmark in a worn rubber-stamp frame. Next: 'faded' variant for post-ending titles.

assets.usage: Title screen backdrop (dynamic dust drawn on top).
assets.brief: Bottom of the drop chute: a heap of lost things lit by the shaft from the slot. Next: parallax layers.
